Reference / runtime/compression

runtime/compression#

The native layer under compression/internal/codec: the calls those modules make into the host runtime.

Version: v1.0.0

Description#

The native layer under compression/internal/codec: the calls those modules make into the host runtime. Programs use those modules instead; these declarations may change with the runtime.

Streaming DEFLATE (RFC 1951) with its zlib (RFC 1950) and gzip (RFC 1952) framings. One state compresses or decompresses one stream; failures are NativeFailure of domain core.compression: invalid_input for damaged data, resource_exhausted past the output limit, invalid_state after the end.

Public API#

native object CodecState#

native object CodecState

A streaming compressor or decompressor.

native codec_open#

native codec_open(format is string, compress is bool, level is int, limit is int) is CodecState

format: "deflate", "zlib" or "gzip". level 0..9 compresses; limit is the most bytes a decompressor may produce in all (positive). Compressing, limit is the size of the whole input when it is known, so the codec sizes its tables for it (zstd), or -1.

native codec_write#

native codec_write(state is CodecState, source is @byte) is @byte

The output that the input makes available now, possibly none.

native codec_finish#

native codec_finish(state is CodecState) is @byte

Compressing: the rest of the output, trailer included. Decompressing: no output, and a failure unless the stream has ended.

native codec_ended#

native codec_ended(state is CodecState) is bool

Whether a decompressor has met the end of its stream.

native codec_remainder#

native codec_remainder(state is CodecState) is @byte

The bytes a decompressor received after the end of its stream.
